sampling_rules: No web/download/codec invocation in this task. Supplier must submit immutable bytes, not filenames or screenshots as byte proof.
Prefer deterministic self-authored synthetic specimens; third-party samples require exact origin, revision and usage permission. No private or executable user content.
Sample one changed risk axis at a time; keep original and derived fixture digests; never substitute MIME or extension for content evidence.
SDK-reported dimensions/duration are measurements with tool version, not approved limits.
Exact format/SDK/limit selection requires Owner; expected accept/reject cases bind that revision before native execution.
Permission and timeout simulation proves only injected seam behavior; native evidence needs isolated environment and different verifier.
Byte identity/provenance availability does not prove decoder safety, correct playback, rendering or full Draft capability.
